_meta.description: Structured upgrade rules derived from meta research. Used as reference for recommendation engine logic.
_meta.changelog: v1.3 (2026-04-01 Pass 4B): Garden max level corrected to 15 (was 20); Fairy Souls confirmed NO stat bonuses since Sept 2022 (now SkyBlock XP + Backpack slots); Rift access confirmed SkyBlock Level 12; Accessories cannot be reforged (replaced by Accessory Powers since Crimson Isle update); Crop upgrades confirmed 9 tiers (+5 FF each) | v1.2 (2026-04-01 Pass 3): slayer order, Bazaar Level 7, Hunting skill, HOTM T10

fairy_souls.stat_bonuses: REMOVED September 2022. Old system gave +HP/Defense/Strength/Speed. Now only SkyBlock XP + Backpack slots.

dungeon_class_meta.healer_note: Effectively obsolete at F6+; not needed in modern party compositions

glacite_tunnels.secret_railroad_pass_recipe: 1 Flawless Ruby + 2 Refined Mithril + 8 Corleonite (30s forge)
glacite_tunnels.recommended_drill: Titanium Drill DR-X555 minimum; DR-X655 for HOTM 10+
glacite_tunnels.recommended_armor: Yog or Divan (NOT Sorrow or Glacite armor)

mining.mithril_mining_note: Nobody mithril mines for income anymore — only for powder. Gemstone mining is the primary income method.

farming_fortune.formula: Every 100 FF = +100% drops. Leftover FF = % chance for one more drop multiplier. Example: 250 FF = 100% chance for 3x drops + 50% chance for 4x drops.

sources.farming_skill: +4 FF per level via Farmhand perk, max +240 at Farming 60 (requires Jacob's contest golds to raise cap 50→60)
sources.anita_extra_ff_perk: +4 FF per tier, 15 tiers max = +60 FF total (costs Jacob's Tickets)
sources.garden_plots: +3 FF per plot unlocked, 24 plots max = +72 FF total
sources.crop_upgrades: +5 FF per tier per crop type, Tier I–IX (9 tiers) = +45 FF max per crop. Bought with Copper. Requires Garden Level to unlock tiers.

pets.elephant: +1.5 FF per level, max +150 at level 100 (LEGENDARY)
pets.mooshroom_cow: +1 FF per level + 10, max +110 at level 100 (LEGENDARY). Has Squash buff + coin multiplier.
pets.bee: +0.2 FF per level, max +20 at level 100
